ns2:course.label: Special Problems
ns2:course.description: Individual investigation of special projects not included in theses. Open to master's candidates for a maximum of 4 graduate hours and to doctoral candidates for a maximum of 12 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Consent from head of department.
